brief: Reads the text or file of a .stzflow document and builds the stzWorkflow it records.
detail: The document is a workflow header with the quoted id, a type line, then sections: steps, each with label, assignedto, duration and sla lines, flow, one from -> to line per arrow, actors with name and role, and roles. The parser keeps no state and it is what ImportFlow uses; ToWorkflow writes the same format. Today a duration of two or more digits is read as text, and an assignedTo line, the spelling ToWorkflow writes, is not read.
receiver:
o1 = new stzFlowParser()
cText = 'workflow "order"' + char(10) + "type: sequential" + char(10) + "steps" + char(10) + "receive" + char(10) + "duration: 5" + char(10) + "pack" + char(10) + "flow" + char(10) + "receive -> pack"
